context.description: Natural-language sequence retrieval context used for internal GO/InterPro term resolution when exact terms are absent or semantic facets are present.
examples: NAD(P)HX repair proteins with dehydratase and epimerase activity

go_term.description: Optional explicit Gene Ontology identifier in GO:NNNNNNN format. When provided, GO sequence retrieval is always run.

interpro_term.description: Optional explicit InterPro accession in IPRNNNNNN format. When provided, InterPro sequence retrieval is always run.

go_terms.description: Bounded GO term records, usually from a resolver. Each record may include term_id, intent_id, label, term_relevance_score, and score_breakdown.

interpro_terms.description: Bounded InterPro term records, usually from a resolver. Each record may include term_id, intent_id, label, term_relevance_score, and score_breakdown.

semantic_intents.description: Optional semantic facets to resolve independently. Each item may include intent_id, label, query, and required.

reviewed.description: If true, prefer reviewed Swiss-Prot records where source APIs support the filter; false restricts to unreviewed records; null returns both.

taxon_id.description: Optional NCBI taxonomy id to restrict returned UniProt sequences. Null disables taxonomy filtering.

temporal_cutoff.description: Optional ISO date (YYYY-MM-DD); only sequences with UniProt entry dates on or before this date are retained.

include_fragments.description: If true, include InterPro sequences flagged by UniProt as fragments. GO retrieval currently ignores this field.

max_sequences.description: Maximum source sequences scanned or kept per retrieval source before downstream candidate bounding.

max_downstream_candidates.description: Maximum final canonical Candidate[] records emitted after source merge, deduplication, scoring, and intent-quota top-K.

timeout_s.description: HTTP timeout in seconds for resolver and source retrieval calls.

include_undated.description: When temporal_cutoff is set, controls whether records lacking a parseable UniProt entry date are included.

min_length.description: Optional minimum sequence length in amino acids.

max_length.description: Optional maximum sequence length in amino acids.

page_size.description: Number of records fetched per remote API page where supported.

max_concurrency.description: Maximum parallel HTTP fetches used by source retrieval adapters.
